// CASE dart_honest expect=pass
Future<void> inOrder<T>(
  Iterable<T> items,
  Future<void> Function(T) step, {
  required String reason,
}) async {
  for (final item in items) {
    consume(await step(item));
  }
}

// CASE dart_distinct_plain expect=fire
Future<void> inOrder<T>(
  Iterable<T> items,
  Future<void> Function(T) step, {
  required String reason,
}) async {
  for (final item in items) {
    consume(await step(item), await save(item));
  }
}

// CASE dart_distinct_interp expect=fire
Future<void> inOrder<T>(
  Iterable<T> items,
  Future<void> Function(T) step, {
  required String reason,
}) async {
  for (final item in items) {
    consume(await step(item), '${await save(item)}');
  }
}

// CASE dart_distinct_triple_interp expect=fire
Future<void> inOrder<T>(
  Iterable<T> items,
  Future<void> Function(T) step, {
  required String reason,
}) async {
  for (final item in items) {
    consume(await step(item), '''${await save(item)}''');
  }
}

// CASE dart_distinct_adjacent expect=fire
Future<void> inOrder<T>(
  Iterable<T> items,
  Future<void> Function(T) step, {
  required String reason,
}) async {
  for (final item in items) {
    consume(
      await step(item),
      'a'
      '${await save(item)}',
    );
  }
}

// CASE dart_distinct_collection_if expect=fire
Future<void> inOrder<T>(
  Iterable<T> items,
  Future<void> Function(T) step, {
  required String reason,
}) async {
  for (final item in items) {
    consume(await step(item), [if (item != null) await save(item)]);
  }
}

// CASE dart_distinct_cascade expect=fire
Future<void> inOrder<T>(
  Iterable<T> items,
  Future<void> Function(T) step, {
  required String reason,
}) async {
  for (final item in items) {
    buffer
      ..add(await step(item))
      ..add(await save(item));
  }
}

// CASE dart_distinct_named_arg expect=fire
Future<void> inOrder<T>(
  Iterable<T> items,
  Future<void> Function(T) step, {
  required String reason,
}) async {
  for (final item in items) {
    consume(await step(item), audit: await save(item));
  }
}

// CASE dart_steps_distinct_interp expect=fire
Future<void> inOrderSteps(
  List<Future<void> Function()> steps, {
  required String reason,
}) async {
  for (final step in steps) {
    consume(await step(), '${await audit()}');
  }
}
